framework.name: EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR 2016/679)
framework.description: European Union regulation establishing personal data processing standards, fundamental privacy rights, Data Controller/Processor obligations, DPIA requirements, 72-hour breach reporting, and administrative fines up to 4% of global annual turnover.

controls.title: Lawful Basis for Personal Data Processing (Art. 6)
controls.description: Data Controllers must document and establish a lawful basis (Consent, Legitimate Interest, Contract, Legal Obligation) prior to processing personal data.

controls.title: Transparent Privacy Notice & Subject Information (Art. 12, 13, 14)
controls.description: Provide concise, transparent, intelligible, and easily accessible privacy notices detailing Controller identity, purpose, retention, and subject rights.

controls.title: Purpose Limitation & Explicit Processing Binding (Art. 5.1.b)
controls.description: Personal data must be collected for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes and not further processed in a manner incompatible with those purposes.

controls.title: Data Minimization & Necessity Scoping (Art. 5.1.c)
controls.description: Personal data collected must be adequate, relevant, and limited strictly to what is necessary in relation to processing purposes.

controls.title: Data Accuracy & Currency Management (Art. 5.1.d)
controls.description: Every reasonable step must be taken to ensure inaccurate personal data is erased or rectified without delay.

controls.title: Storage Limitation & Automated Data Purging (Art. 5.1.e)
controls.description: Personal data must be kept in a form permitting identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for specified processing purposes.

controls.title: Right to Erasure / Right to be Forgotten (Art. 17)
controls.description: Data subjects have the right to obtain from the Controller the erasure of personal data without undue delay under statutory grounds.

controls.title: Encryption at Rest and in Transit for PII (Art. 32.1.a)
controls.description: Implement state-of-the-art encryption (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit) for all systems processing personal data.

controls.title: Pseudonymization & Data Masking (Art. 32.1.a)
controls.description: Apply pseudonymization and data masking to isolate personal data identifiers from underlying data records during storage and processing.

controls.title: Access Control & Role-Based Privileges (Art. 32.1.b)
controls.description: Enforce strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) to ensure ongoing confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

controls.title: Regular Security Resilience Testing & Assessment (Art. 32.1.d)
controls.description: Establish a process for regularly testing, assessing, and evaluating the effectiveness of technical and organizational security measures.

controls.title: 72-Hour Personal Data Breach Notification to Supervisory Authority (Art. 33)
controls.description: In case of a personal data breach, Controllers must notify the competent Supervisory Authority within 72 hours of becoming aware.
evidence_checklist: EU DPA Breach Incident SLA Playbook

controls.title: Data Subject Breach Notification Protocol (Art. 34)
controls.description: When a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to rights and freedoms, Controllers must notify affected data subjects without undue delay.

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA Art. 35)
controls.description: Where processing is likely to result in high risk, Controllers must carry out a DPIA prior to the processing activity.

controls.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO) Designation (Art. 37)
controls.description: Designate a Data Protection Officer (DPO) where processing is carried out by a public authority or involves regular monitoring or large-scale sensitive data.

controls.title: Data Processor Binding Contracts & DPA Enforcement (Art. 28)
controls.description: Processing by a Processor must be governed by a binding contract (DPA) setting out processing subject matter, duration, nature, and purpose.

controls.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Safeguards (Art. 44-49)
controls.description: Transfers of personal data to third countries must satisfy Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs), or Adequacy Decisions.

controls.title: Record of Processing Activities (ROPA Art. 30)
controls.description: Maintain a central, up-to-date Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) documenting Controller/Processor categories, data types, and retention periods.
